Flag Feeder Errors (Casey et al. 2005)

Source: R/flag_feed_errors.R
flag_feed_errors.Rd

Flag each visit with the 16 error types of Casey et al. (2005).

flag_feed_errors(visits, qc = qc_config(), bw = NULL, verbose = 1)

Arguments

visits

Visit table from prep_visits(). Keep the unidentified visits: they are part of the feeder sequence.

qc

QC settings from qc_config(). Used here: fiv_range, fiv0_abs_max, duration_max, speed_fiv_lo_max, speed_strict_max, speed_range, idle_duration_max, trough_diff_range, max_unidentified_feed_kg, fiv_max_by_weight.

bw

Optional daily body weight of each pig, used to look up fiv_max_by_weight: a data frame with responder, date and bw (kg), such as the fitted weights of calc_adg(). calc_adfi() passes them automatically. Without it, the daily median of the recorded weights is used; early in the test these are often biased upwards by outliers.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (rate of each error type).

Value

The visit table (all visits) with added columns:

  • fiv, otv, frv, lwd, fwd, ltd, ftd: the seven variables;

  • one logical column per error type (fiv_lo, fiv_hi, fiv_0, otv_lo, otv_hi, frv_hi_fiv_lo, frv_hi_strict, frv_hi, frv_0, frv_lo, lwd_lo, lwd_hi, fwd_lo, fwd_hi, ltd_lo, ftd_lo);

  • fiv_max: the FIV-hi limit used for the visit (g), fixed or from fiv_max_by_weight;

  • n_errors: number of error types of the visit (0 = error-free).

Attributes "feeders" (per feeder: visits, unidentified visits, feed disappearance in unidentified visits, error rate) and "error_rates" (share of identified visits with each error type) summarise the result. The attributes of visits are kept.

References

Casey, D. S., Stern, H. S., & Dekkers, J. C. M. (2005). Identification of errors and factors associated with errors in data from electronic swine feeders. Journal of Animal Science, 83, 969-982.

See also

prep_visits() for the previous step, calc_adfi() which uses the flags.

Examples

visits <- prep_visits(fire, verbose = 0)
flagged <- flag_feed_errors(visits, verbose = 2)
#> 
#> ── Flagging feeder errors (Casey et al. 2005) ──────────────────────────────────
#> ℹ Visits with at least one error: 2.62% of 9743 identified visits
#> • FRV-lo: 64 (0.66%)
#> • LWD-hi: 60 (0.62%)
#> • FWD-hi: 60 (0.62%)
#> • FIV-lo: 33 (0.34%)
#> • FRV-hi: 28 (0.29%)
#> • FIV-hi: 21 (0.22%)
#> • LWD-lo: 5 (0.05%)
#> • FRV-hi-strict: 4 (0.04%)
#> • FWD-lo: 4 (0.04%)
#> • FRV-0: 1 (0.01%)
attr(flagged, "feeders")
#>    location n_visits n_unidentified unidentified_feed_kg error_rate
#>      <char>    <int>          <int>                <num>      <num>
#> 1:      101     6014             30                2.148 0.01788102
#> 2:      102     3780             21                0.621 0.03937217
